notes: Gest Street is offset at Freeman: east of Freeman it is 50 ft (block lines y 285/460, centre 374), west of Freeman it is 60 ft (lines 506/717, centre 611), so two T-junctions on Freeman. The Gest width entry is the 50 ft printed east of Freeman. Pine Street and Jordan Street (printed PINE and JORDAN with no suffix) enter Gest from the north only (sheet 60/61 side). Jordan is only about 11 ft wide (lines x 2794/2833). Gest ends at Baymiller, which continues north. The unnamed 10 ft north-south alley at x ~1083 (6 inch water pipe) runs from Gest to West Court (in 'alleys'). Gest Alley (printed GEST ALLEY) runs from it east to Baymiller; its west-end T with the unnamed alley is recorded with '' as the alley name. The unnamed 9th-8th alley (in 'alleys') ends at Baymiller on this sheet's outline, but sheet 51 shows it continuing east of Baymiller (slightly offset north), so the Baymiller point is also recorded as a crossing with ''. Gest Alley is printed 10' at its west end and 16' at Baymiller (16 recorded). West Court ends at Freeman from the east (no opening west of Freeman). PENNOCK ALLEY and CEDAR ALLEY each run from Freeman to Baymiller and cross it into openings on the sheet 51 side; the east openings are offset north (Pennock: west arm centre y 2014, east opening y 1947-2020, centre ~1984; Cedar: west arm y 2994, east opening y 2962-3000, centre ~2981), so the Baymiller points sit midway between the two arms. Names of the east arms are not printed here. Freeman drifts from x ~643 at the top to ~619 at 8th (scan skew); points use the block lines on both sides.
